Welcome

Welcome to Santorini Beach Hut

One of the picturesque pastel-coloured beach huts at West Mersea, Santorini Beach Hut is the perfect setting for fun family beach days, relaxing seaside escapes, and peaceful moments watching the tide roll in from your private decking area, overlooking the beautiful Blackwater Estuary.

Perfect for family and friend get-togethers, quieter midweek escapes and relaxing coastal days. Mersea Island sits where the Blackwater Estuary meets the North Sea and is well known for its famous oysters, scenic coastal walks, sailing and water sports. There is also an annual sailing regatta which brings a wonderful family-friendly atmosphere to the island in August.

The pastel-coloured beach huts on Mersea Island have been named among the UK's most Instagrammed beach huts.

Under new ownership for 2026. Santorini Beach Hut begins a new chapter this year — the same Greek-inspired hut, the same front-row spot on the sand, lovingly looked after for the season ahead.

The Experience

Experience the Beach Hut

Step through the open doors into a little corner of the Aegean: a hand-painted Santorini mural, bougainvillea by the door, a mosaic table for slow mornings — and beyond the private gated decking, the tide rolling in across the Blackwater Estuary.

Facilities & Little Extras

Everything's Here — Just Bring Yourselves

Inside the hut you'll find two windbreaks, a parasol, crockery, cutlery, kettle, small gas stove, tea towels and throws — plus complimentary refreshments and a private, gated decking area outside. Free parking for one car is available directly behind the beach hut.

Parking

Free parking for one car directly behind the hut — collect the keys and barrier fob from the key box at the back of the hut when you arrive.

Toilets

Toilets at The Sandbank Pub & Restaurant just behind the hut, with extra toilets and showers on the holiday park.

Restaurant

The Sandbank Restaurant & Pub — dog friendly, with seasonal opening — is just behind the hut, with a children's play area alongside.

Dog-friendly beach

The beach is dog-friendly all year round. Up to 2 well-behaved dogs are welcome, with a complimentary dog bowl and treats provided.

Beach amenities

Two windbreaks, a parasol, deckchairs and loungers, a picnic rug, beach toys and games, a Bluetooth radio, baby changing and washing-up things.

Outdoor decking

A private gated decking area with a table and chairs, right on the sand in the front row — your own spot for the whole day.

Complimentary refreshments. A variety of complimentary tea, coffee and hot chocolate, plus sweets, biscuits and refreshments waiting for you — and a freshwater tap is just a few huts along.

A Day by the Sea

Made for Memorable Days

However you spend it — a big family get-together, a quiet midweek escape, or a birthday on the decking — the hut, the beach and the estuary do the rest.

Family get-togethers

Room for up to 8 on the hut and decking combined, beach toys and games for the children, and the play area just behind on the park.

Peaceful escapes

Quieter midweek days, a throw over your knees and the tide rolling in — stay until the early-evening check-out and watch the light change.

Dog-friendly beach days

The beach is dog-friendly all year round. Up to 2 well-behaved dogs can join you, with a dog bowl, treats and a dog washing area on the park.

Celebrations by the sea

Birthdays, afternoon teas and surprise get-togethers — the decking makes a beautiful backdrop for a special day.

Explore West Mersea

Right Behind You: Food, Drink & Island Days

Santorini sits on West Mersea Holiday Park, so lunch, ice cream and the children's play area are all a short stroll from your decking — and the island beyond is famous for its oysters, coastal walks, sailing and water sports.

Sandbank Restaurant & Pub

Dog friendly and just behind the beach hut (seasonal opening), with a children's play area, green space for games, a dog washing area and a large screen showing occasional sporting events. Toilets are here too — just 10 metres from the hut.

West Mersea Holiday Park

Children's outdoor play area, toilets and showers, green space for games — everything a family beach day needs, right where you're staying for the day.

At the park entrance

Vivi's Gift Shop — newspapers, sweets, drinks and a selection of gifts and beach toys.

Seaview Beach Diner — indoor and outdoor seating, eat in or takeaway… plus ice cream and cake!

On the island: Mersea is well known for its famous oysters, scenic coastal walks, sailing and water sports — and each August the annual sailing regatta brings a wonderful family-friendly atmosphere to the island.

Getting Here

Finding Beach Hut 90

The address

Beach Hut 90, West Mersea Holiday Park,
Seaview Avenue, West Mersea, Essex CO5 8DA

Sat Nav: West Mersea Holiday Park, Colchester CO5 8DA. Front row on the sand — parking 0m, beach 0m, toilet 10m, shower 30m, freshwater tap 10m.

By car — arrival & keys

  • Temporarily park in the Sales Office car park, just before the security barrier.
  • Walk to the hut and collect the keys and security barrier fob from the key box at the back of the hut.
  • With the fob, park one car directly behind the hut — free. No fob is needed to exit.
  • Please don't park behind any other beach huts.
  • Bringing more than one car? Use Seaview Car Park near the park entrance (Blue Badge Holders parking available).

By train & bus

Train: Colchester Town Station or Colchester Station — then a taxi of approximately 20–30 minutes to West Mersea Holiday Park.

Bus: the closest bus stop is near Seaview Avenue — walk down Seaview Avenue towards the beach, and West Mersea Holiday Park is at the bottom on the left.

Check the tides before you travel

These directions are just a guide, so please check travel routes beforehand, making note of the tide times. Mersea Island is reached by a causeway, so tide times matter.

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

Check in between 9:30am and 12:30pm — no arrivals are allowed outside this window. Check out between 6:30pm and 7:30pm.
A maximum of 8 occupants at any one time, inside the hut and on the decking combined — including adults, children, babies and up to 2 well-behaved dogs. This is a licence condition and is strictly adhered to. Bringing more than 2 dogs? Please enquire first.
Yes — the beach is dog-friendly all year round. A dog bowl and complimentary treats are provided at the hut, and there's a dog washing area at the Sandbank Restaurant & Pub on the park.
Two windbreaks, a parasol, crockery, cutlery, kettle, small gas stove, tea towels, throws, deckchairs and loungers, a picnic rug, beach toys and games, a Bluetooth radio, baby changing and washing-up things — plus a private, gated decking area.
A variety of complimentary tea, coffee and hot chocolate, plus sweets, biscuits and refreshments — and a dog bowl with treats for four-legged guests.
Free parking for one car is available directly behind the beach hut. On arrival, temporarily park in the Sales Office car park before the security barrier, collect the keys and barrier fob from the key box at the back of the hut, then park behind the hut. Extra cars can use Seaview Car Park near the park entrance.
Toilets are available at The Sandbank Pub & Restaurant just behind the beach hut (about 10 metres), with additional toilets and showers located nearby on the holiday park (showers about 30 metres). A freshwater tap is just a few huts along.
The Sandbank Restaurant & Pub (dog friendly, seasonal opening) is just behind the hut. At the park entrance you'll find Vivi's Gift Shop for newspapers, sweets, drinks, gifts and beach toys, and the Seaview Beach Diner for eat-in or takeaway food, ice cream and cake.
Yes — please check travel routes beforehand and make note of the tide times, as Mersea Island is reached by a causeway. You can view tide times via StroodCam.
Free cancellation up to 7 days before check-in (minus a £10.00 admin fee); after that the booking is non-refundable. There is also free cancellation within 24 hours of booking if check-in is at least 7 days away.
Bookings and enquiries are made through our BeachHuts.com booking page, or message us on Instagram at @santorinibeachhutwestmersea. Terms & Conditions are sent with your booking confirmation and are also available on the Instagram page.
